name: globe
description: Minimal COBE WebGL globe. Vanilla canvas, reusable as figure, scene, or backdrop.

variant.description: figure (inline), scene (large stage), or backdrop (behind other content).

size.description: CSS pixel size of the canvas square. Defaults: figure 360, scene 560, backdrop 720.

theme.description: auto (follow site mode), light, or dark.

drag.description: Pointer-drag to rotate. Default true for figure, false for backdrop.

effect.description: Named look: builders, users, ai, chain, or a custom id. Live-updatable via site-globe:effect.

markers.description: [{ lat, lon, size? }]. size is relative to globe radius.

arcs.description: [{ from: [lat, lon], to: [lat, lon] }] or { fromLat, fromLon, toLat, toLon }.
